narrative.northStar: The Sticker Sheet on Warm Paper
narrative.overview: Everybird is an Operate surface wearing Yusuf's personal-site clothes. The birds are the only colour and illustration; everything else is warm paper, near-black ink, one deep red and hairlines. The collage page mirrors /lifelist exactly.
keyCharacteristics: Light by default, dark by toggle
Flat with hairlines; shadows only on floating things
One accent for selection, focus and the primary action
Mono uppercase labels for numbers and meta

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Accent marks this one: the selected chip, the current tab, the primary action, the focus ring.

rules.name: The Quiet Disabled Rule
rules.body: Disabled is Surface fill, Hairline border, Muted text, never a paler Accent.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No shadow on anything that does not float over the page.

rules.name: The Squircle Rule
rules.body: Corners are superellipses with the .566 fallback factor.

dos: Do copy /lifelist exactly for shared patterns, and use the seven tokens through var(--...).
Do use the Squircle Rule for every new rounded surface and 44px targets.
Do keep Accent for selection, focus and the primary action only.
Do write the credit wherever a sticker appears.
Do honour reduced motion and the 1,500-bird fade in anything that animates many birds.
donts: Don't add icons to filter chips, shadows at rest, a second accent, gradients, or prefers-color-scheme.
Don't commit font files, personal data or coordinates, or ship the photo-or-recording mark.
Don't animate layout properties on birds.
Don't put em dashes, emoji or exclamation marks in copy.
